_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so an Environment extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers would be built from pulse condition tokens (temperature_anomaly, forest_loss...) plus active diagnosis ids (CLIMATE_TIPPING_POINT...). This table bridges raw condition tokens to the diagnosis ids and circuit brainNodeIds they actually imply. As in Finance, activation.diagnosticTriggers ARE diagnosis ids, so diagnosis ids self-match; the condition-token map is the part strictly required.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition token --(environment-pulse-engine.js inline classify, L142-174)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies OR-gate, L52-98 / L184-187)--> diagnosis id --(environment.json issues[]._authored circuit; adapter would use is._authored||is.circuits)--> circuit brainNodeIds --(those nodeIds are activations whose diagnosticTriggers are themselves diagnosis ids)--> diagnosticTriggers.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition token only when a family the token EMITS appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies. This matches the ACTUAL code gate (environment-pulse-engine.js checks requiredFamilies only; primaryIndicators/secondaryConfirmation are metadata not used by the validity gate). The primaryIndicator/secondaryConfirmation/requiredFamily-only provenance is recorded per link but the fold is on requiredFamily membership.
_provenance.tokenVsIndicatorMismatches: Three classify tokens differ from the contract named primaryIndicator spelling and therefore link ONLY via emitted family, not as a named indicator: 'sea_level' (contract lists 'sea_level_rise'), 'invasive_species' (contract lists 'invasive_spread'), 'ocean_chemistry' (contract lists 'ocean_chemistry_shift'). They still ground because their emitted family is a requiredFamily. Recorded honestly rather than silently treated as named indicators.
_provenance.climateDualLink: Every climate_event token (temperature_anomaly, climate_volatility, sea_level, carbon_budget_breach, extreme_weather) folds BOTH CLIMATE_TIPPING_POINT and OCEAN_ACIDIFICATION, because OCEAN_ACIDIFICATION requiredFamilies include climate_event (L73). This is real per the code, not an over-mark.
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Condition tokens with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Extinction matching is case-insensitive per the Energy reference (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinance: DIFFERENT engine shape. (1) Finance and Energy expose named condition-CODES (bank_failure, crude_above_90); Environment has NO named condition-codes - its pulse engine classifies RAW condition tokens (temperature_anomaly, forest_loss) straight to families inline (no classify() over a distinct event vocabulary). The conditionCodes section here is therefore keyed by those raw tokens. (2) Environment contracts gate on requiredFamilies ONLY (no separate secondary-family gate in code), so folding is purely requiredFamily membership. (3) Environment has TWO dead-end families: structural_event (from environment_high_stress/structural_stress) and macro_event (from macro_shock) - NEITHER appears in any contract requiredFamilies, so both are unmapped (Finance had one dead-end, macro_event; Energy had zero). (4) Environment uses _clonePhantom indirection (GBA->Soil-ENS, DAN->FEF, FPN->dlPFC) inside _authored circuits - a wrinkle neither Finance nor Energy had, and the source of the phantom-only orphans below. (5) Orphan count: Energy 1, Finance 3, Environment 2 hard plus 2 phantom-only.

activationsWithTriggersButNoTriggerSourc.reason: HARD ORPHAN. Activation has diagnosticTriggers but its brainNodeId appears in NO issue._authored circuit (VTA is not in the authored union {HYPO,PIN,DV,ENS,FPN,PBN,MICRO,BLA,GBA,EC,vmPFC,DAN,NTS,dACC}), no condition-token chain reaches it, and it has no _clonePhantom. Under current wiring nothing marks it active, so extinction would ALWAYS list it for retirement. No grounded alias exists; NOT fabricated. Needs authoring into an issue circuit before extinction should touch it.
HARD ORPHAN. Same as VTA: brainNodeId S1 not in any _authored circuit, no phantom, has triggers -> always an extinction candidate with no grounded activation source. Not fabricated; needs authoring.

activationsReachableOnlyViaClonePhantom.reason: PHANTOM-ONLY. brainNodeId FEF is NOT in any _authored circuit, but its _clonePhantom 'DAN' IS (MASS_EXTINCTION and TOXIC_CONTAMINATION circuits reference DAN). Reachable ONLY if the adapter resolves _clonePhantom (DAN->FEF) when matching circuit nodeIds to activation brainNodeIds. Under STRICT brainNodeId matching (the Energy adapter default) FEF is an orphan and extinction would retire it; under phantom-resolving matching it is grounded. Flagged so the adapter matching mode is chosen deliberately, not by accident.

PHANTOM-ONLY. brainNodeId dlPFC is NOT in any _authored circuit, but its _clonePhantom 'FPN' IS (CLIMATE_TIPPING_POINT circuit references FPN). Same phantom-resolution dependency as FEF/DAN. Orphan under strict brainNodeId matching; grounded under phantom-resolving matching.

activationsUnreachableButExemptFromExtin.reason: Unreachable by any issue circuit, but diagnosticTriggers is empty, so energy-extinction.js L30 skips it entirely (never an extinction candidate). No alias needed.

Unreachable by any _authored issue circuit, and diagnosticTriggers empty -> extinction-exempt. (Note: CeA IS referenced by graph edges mPFC->CeA / vmPFC->CeA, but not by any issue _authored circuit and has no triggers.) No alias needed.

clonePhantomResolution.note: Environment _authored circuits reference three nodeIds that are NOT activation brainNodeIds but ARE _clonePhantom values of activations. Recorded so any consuming adapter resolves them consistently.

map.ambiguity: brainNodeId 'ENS' is ALSO used literally by a DIFFERENT activation (Forests & Carbon Sinks). Literal ENS circuit refs (CLIMATE/DEFORESTATION) match Forests-ENS by brainNodeId; GBA circuit refs (MASS/DEFORESTATION/TOXIC) match Soil-ENS by phantom. Both ENS activations can be marked active.

contractOnlyTokensNotClassified.reason: N/A for Environment: contracts carry primaryIndicator/secondaryConfirmation LABELS (e.g. sea_level_rise, invasive_spread, ecosystem_disruption, pollinator_collapse, soil_degradation) that the inline classify switch does NOT emit, but those are indicator labels, not runtime condition tokens; the runtime only ever sees the classify tokens. Every classify token either grounds (folds a diagnosis) or is unmapped (structural_stress, environment_high_stress, macro_shock).
